summary: Environment A direct-binary verification for the Phase 7.3 Windows rebuild (remove-enrollment command, completing the enrollment CRUD lifecycle) - like Phase 7.1/7.2, this phase changes Rust code compiled into the desktop binary, so a genuine rebuild with direct binary proof is required.
buildResult: Rust build succeeded (whisper-rs-sys ggml lib-name two-pass fix applied as expected on the first-attempt failure, unrelated to this phase's own changes); pnpm build (tsc -b && vite build) succeeded producing a fresh dist/assets bundle; NSIS packaging finished with the three runtime DLLs confirmed present by the script's own built-in check.

installer.fileSizeDeltaNote: A small net increase, consistent with adding one new command plus a Remove button and its handler in the frontend bundle - the installer's SHA-256 changing, plus the newSymbolsThisPhase entry below, are the decisive proof this rebuild reflects this phase's real code.

extractionMethod: 7z x against the built installer into a scratch directory; confirmed exit code 0 and listed contents.

symbolRegressionCheck.method: x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings/nm against the extracted cip-desktop.exe, re-run for every prior-phase symbol/string this project has established as a regression tripwire.

whisper_full_with_state.note: Investigated, not a regression - the exact same non-deterministic strings/grep -c line-count artifact this project has already documented and named for this specific symbol (see pilot-evidence/7.2/windows: 'Stable at 93... Phase 6.2 through 7.2', itself following a one-time 96->93 drift originally observed at Phase 6.2). No file in ai/speech, integrations/audio, or any whisper-rs-touching path changed in this phase - only apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands.rs, lib.rs, and the music-acoustic-adjacent frontend files changed. Manually reviewed the raw strings output for this build: all 96 matching lines are whisper.cpp's own C++ template-instantiation symbols for a beam-search lambda inside whisper_full_with_state (std::thread::_State_impl<...> specializations, .text$/.xdata$/.pdata$ section-header duplicates of the same mangled names, and __gnu_cxx/std sort-algorithm instantiations over the function-local beam_candidate type) - the exact same fan-out this symbol has always produced, just split across a different number of coalesced strings-output lines than the immediately prior rebuild. x86_64-w64-mingw32-nm -C confirms the real exported whisper_full_with_state function symbol itself, and every Rust-side symbol tracked above, is unchanged. Treated with the same transparency discipline as every prior line-count artifact this project has encountered (get_service_report, Phase 7.1) rather than silently smoothed over.

symbolRegressionCheck.conclusion: Every Rust-side symbol/string count this project tracks is exactly unchanged. The one count that differs (whisper_full_with_state) is a previously-documented, investigated strings/grep line-coalescing artifact in unmodified whisper.cpp C++ symbols, not a functional regression - confirmed by cargo test --workspace --features whisper passing clean in the same regression pass that produced this build.

newSymbolsThisPhase.method: x86_64-w64-mingw32-nm -C against the extracted cip-desktop.exe, searching for this phase's own new function name - direct proof the real remove-enrollment code actually compiled into this exact binary.
newSymbolsThisPhase.conclusion: The expected new symbol is present with a real, distinct address - direct proof this phase's implementation is compiled into this exact packaged .exe. No new crate-level symbol was expected (this phase composes Phase 7.2's read_manifest_entries/write_manifest_entries as-is), and none appeared.

newStringsSearched: Removed. Restart CIP for it to take effect.
frontendTextSearch.conclusion: Reproduces the established Tauri-frontend-bundle tooling limitation (documented since Phase 6.1) a tenth time for UI copy specifically - the control string itself returns 0 matches, so the 0 matches for this phase's own new UI text say nothing about correctness either way. The command-name string 'remove_acoustic_reference' itself (used by both the Rust #[tauri::command] registration and the frontend's invoke() call) does appear, at the same count (2) as every other single-command name in this codebase's symbol table. Correctness for the frontend surface rests on npm run typecheck's success, the fresh Vite build producing a new asset bundle hash, and the full 262/262 frontend test pass already recorded in pilot-evidence/7.3/build/remove-enrollment-evidence.json.

architecturalSafetyNotes: Exactly one new Tauri command (remove_acoustic_reference), zero new events, zero new database schema, zero new crate-level symbols.
core/music (the domain contract crate) has zero symbol-level changes.
NullAcousticMusicRecognizer/ScriptedAcousticMusicRecognizer's compiled symbols are unchanged from the Phase 7.2 baseline.

enroll_acoustic_reference/list_acoustic_enrollments and every read_manifest_entries/validate_reference_wav/write_manifest_entries symbol from Phase 7.2 are present and unchanged - confirmed by direct nm lookup, not just absence of a regression flag.
